## Plan

(Phase 1 — see Test matrix; refined after baseline reconfirm)

1. `hh-embed` (the render half of the B.2 retained-view→wire owner —
   the gap the dossier named: `GatewayModel::transcript` replays the
   full durable prefix and resurrects omitted transcript):
   - `transcript()`/`build_plan()` consult the **latest** durable
     `context.compaction.completed{selection}` member in the prefix:
     strict `RetainedSelection::from_json` decode +
     `verify_selection` (R5.18 consumed unchanged) — a malformed,
     unknown-policy, unverifiable or divergent record is a typed
     `ModelErrorClass::MalformedHistory` plan refusal (zero bytes,
     honest `plan_error`), never a silent resurrection.
   - On `Reproduced`: the rendered observation join drops items the
     recorded selection omitted (the `context_item_id` derivation is
     the assembler's own `idp_id("hh.embed.context_item/1", canonical
     payload)` — one shared `pub(crate)` constant); a tool pair whose
     result was omitted renders the honest `no_observation_recorded`
     placeholder; post-selection items render normally.
   - `requested_members` stamps `view_hash` (the landed §5b.1 member
     spelling — same as prepared.rs's request row) = the consumed
     `retained_selection/1` member's idp address — the same value
     `prepare` computes as `view_ref` over the same member.
   - No new public type/class/event names; `MalformedHistory` is an
     already-landed class.
2. `crates/hh-embed/tests/r5_20.rs` — battery per the test matrix:
   real `compact()` outcomes mint real `selection` members (r5_18
   fixture discipline); `GatewayModel` as `ModelPort` over a loopback
   fake provider (r4_5b pattern — real socket bytes); the prepared
   leg via `hharness_gateway::prepared` + scratch `Store`/`Account`/
   `ManualClock` + capture `Transport` (r5_19 pattern) — the full
   policy→selection→assembly→sealed-request→actual-wire join is
   byte-exact at every step.
3. Docs/records: coverage dated contributing note (AC-3); ADR only if
   a MET-DIFFERENTLY verdict or owned decision arises; run ledger +
   PR record.

## Test matrix

| AC | planned test |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | evict_oldest: real compact over tool-result observations → selection member → `requested_members`+`call` → loopback-captured body bytes contain every retained item's content and no omitted byte; `view_hash` member = selection idp; prepared leg `request_bytes` == render-serialized plan, dispatched bytes == `request_bytes` |
| AC-1 | clear_tool_results: CTR parameters pinned (`capabilities`,`older_than`,`completed_invocations`); omitted tool results absent from wire, retained invocations present; required/recent items protected |
| AC-1 | restart: selection consumed identically after store/prefix re-drive (same prefix → same captured bytes); retry: a second `requested_members`/`call` over the unchanged prefix sends byte-identical body; fallback: declared CTR ineffective → evict_oldest ladder rung applies (pipeline_index>0) → render honors the recorded fallback selection |
| AC-2 | resurrection negative: a prefix without/with a divergent selection must not yield omitted bytes on the wire (byte-level scan) — fails without the filter |
| AC-2 | strategy label without execution: tampered retained set (Diverged), unknown `variant_ref` (UnknownPolicy), missing trigger (TriggerAbsent), protected-group omit (ProtectedGroup) → `plan_error` typed refusal, provider sees zero requests |
| AC-2 | unknown provider capability: `prepare` over a plan asserting an unadmitted capability/endpoint → `InvalidPlan`, zero dispatch (existing gates — asserted through this battery) |
| AC-2 | changed sealed bytes: presented plan mutated between prepare and dispatch → `PreparedBytesMutated`, zero bytes sent |
| AC-2 | no trigger/next call: untriggered selection (`omitted` empty) renders the full view + `view_hash` names the record (fidelity is the record's `status`, not a treatment claim); absent `selection` member → no `view_hash` member and no treatment claim |
| AC-4 | fails-without: the render filter is the only change; omit-filter removed → omitted payload bytes reappear on the wire (the AC-1/AC-2 asserts go red) |

(numstat vs base `f99d806c`, code+test only — docs/records excluded.)

The weight is the proof surface, not padding: the battery must
(i) drive the **real** `compact()` ladder for real `retained_selection/1`
members (r5_18 fixture discipline — candidates, plans, triggers),
(ii) build the durable prefix envelopes the render reads, (iii) stand
the loopback provider that captures **literal socket bytes**, and
(iv) stand the prepared leg (`Store`/`Account`/`ManualClock`/
`EndpointAllowlist`/capture `Transport` — r5_19 infra) so the
policy→selection→assembly→sealed-request→actual-wire joins are
byte-exact at every step, for both admitted policies plus restart,
fallback, retry and the five AC-2 negative cells. No AC was dropped.

**Seam analysis (vs the R5.19-review precedent).** The only
candidate cut is (a) the render integration + its hh-embed battery
vs (b) the prepared-join legs — but AC-1's single predicate
("retained view→existing renderer→sealed request bytes") spans both:
leg (a) without (b) leaves "sealed request" unproven at the landed
`request_bytes`/`request_ref` boundary; leg (b) without (a) feeds the
seal a synthetic plan, not the renderer's — the join AC-2 demands
("exact … joins") is unenforced either way, the same objection the
R5.19 scoped review found ("a split buys an over-trigger leg by
fragmenting one admitted unit"). No documented seam exists in Packet
B for a render-vs-seal split — B.2 names ONE owner seam across
hh-gateway + hh-embed render.

**Magnitude:** ~2.3× is inside the accepted band (≤2.6× R5.8;
~1.85–2.4× routinely amended incl. R5.19 at ~1.93×).

**Proposed disposition:** AMEND (as R5.19's `2026-11-03_R5.19-
split-review.md` ruled) — land the battery as one unit; the
implementation is complete, green, fails-without proven, and already
checkpointed at `2209c5d5` on `codex/harnessharness-evidence-r5.20`
for review.
